headline: Allison Posts Q3 2026 Sales Surge Supported by Transformation
summary: Allison released its Q3 2026 slides, reporting a 121% jump in sales driven by ongoing business transformation efforts.
why: Significant revenue jumps reflect corporate turnaround progress and operational execution, impacting valuation multiples.
